question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 as the canonical Matrix missing-key recovery fix for this issue, or require a different API boundary before merge?
rationale: The bug is real enough to keep open, but landing the fix changes Matrix retry/session-state behavior and overlaps with another open candidate, so automated cleanup should not choose or merge the implementation alone.

options.title: Accept PR94416 As Canonical
options.body: Land the focused decrypt-bridge retry-state repair after normal checks, then close this issue and close or supersede the broader overlapping PR.

options.title: Request An API Seam First
options.body: Ask the contributor to reshape the retry into an approved Matrix SDK/API boundary before this issue can close.

options.title: Prefer The Broader Candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94044 only if maintainers intentionally want broader sync-error recovery despite its current review concerns.
